description: Rows of numbers compared across 2 to 8 measures at once: each measure is a vertical axis with its own scale, and each row is one line that crosses every axis at its value, so clusters, trade-offs and outliers across many measures show as bundles of lines. Optionally the lines are coloured by one measure (a light-to-dark ramp from the theme accent, with a legend giving the range). Axis scales come from d3 scaleLinear nice() and ticks() and the lines from d3 line(), computed on the server, so there is no script. The picture is static: the interactive brushing of a Plotly parallel-coordinates chart (dragging on an axis to filter rows) is not available. A hidden table gives every value of every row.
